control_panel.name: Motion Graphics Controls
control_panel.comments: optional _comment_<control> strings beside values; excluded from motion evaluation
control_panel.persistence: explicit Apply & Save JSON; validated atomic replacement with prior-byte backup and stale-input checks
control_panel.drafts: panel edits take effect after Apply & Save; external edits do not overwrite an unapplied draft
control_panel.invalid_input: persistent panel reason, syntax location/excerpt or rejected field/range; keep last valid motion
control_panel.usd_writes: no additional writer; existing runtime consumes the saved DATA JSON
control_panel.playback: explicit Play/Pause callbacks use the USD context's timeline and stage frame range; automatic advancement enabled on Play if needed and restored on disconnect
control_panel.connection_status: live/baked mode, playing/paused state, seconds and runtime-update counter; warns about stalled time, detached/muted runtime, missing target, visibility and masking opinions
control_panel.playback_readback: automatically wait for Play and three advancing snapshots; report sampled USD/Fabric position changes in panel and log; no claim of rendered-image verification
control_panel.reconnect: reload saved controls and recreate the owned overlay/watcher; discard unsaved panel draft; preserve other scene contributions
control_panel.acceptance: panel startup, control saves and changing USD/Fabric values observed in Kit; user reports visible motion only after restarting Kit and reloading the scene; automatic viewport refresh and full lifecycle remain under development
control_panel.input_source_status: local JSON is an editable mock data source, not a server or live connector
control_panel.viewport_observation: manual Kit restart and scene reload restored visible motion in the user's session; cause is not established

runtime.precedence: runtime arrays override baked arrays; direct Session opinions can still mask them
runtime.clock: USD context's Kit timeline seconds; no wall-clock accumulation
runtime.sampling: two time samples per owned array at current stage time code and one code ahead; matching timeCodesPerSecond; prune old samples; no live defaults or accumulated recording
runtime.stale_input: hold last valid controls and continue timeline; report error
runtime.stop: disable live_preview or stop helper removes owned overlay, exposing bake
runtime.reload: stage replacement/rerun tears down old tasks/overlay

limitations: runtime undo uses overlay removal; no per-frame undo commands
prototype/source edits invalidate the conservative extent assumption
Kit playback, point-instancer rendering and throughput not verified
